rationale: In vivo screen of 355 myeloid-biased transmembrane-protein genes (3,547 guides, about 10 per gene, no non-targeting controls) in Cas9 haematopoietic progenitors transplanted into irradiated mice; CD45+ cells from B16-F10 tumours were compared with bone marrow of the same mice. One pooled library per tissue, so run_barcs.R uses the no-replicate path; without control guides the overdispersion is pooled over all guides (conservative), and the calls are screening-level. Knockouts that prevent accumulation of the cells in the tumour (Cd300ld in the paper) are depleted in tumour vs bone marrow.
